test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 7 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Eight friends P, Q, R, S, T, U, V and W are sitting in two lines, with four friends sitting in each line. Both the lines are facing north. The four persons in the back line are exactly behind the four persons in the front line. P is between T and W. Q is just behind T. Q, who is to the immediate left of S, is also at one of the corners in the back line. R is between S and U. Who is sitting between P and V?
solution:
Eight friends P, Q, R, S, T, U, V and W are sitting in two lines, with four friends sitting in each line. Both the lines are facing north.

The four persons in the back line are exactly behind the four persons in the front line.

1) P is between T and W.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d04e31c37df0bc130dc1f6f844886a317e398ff6b7af92ef0757d1bbcfc73275.png] 

2) Q is just behind T.

3) Q, who is to the immediate left of S, is also at one of the corners in the back line.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/99e8e10d00b486585c4dc2e0b1968608f4cd15e86631348875d912dfa825103b.png] 

4) R is between S and U.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0ce30ba8ba84cfbc10a0c826d709b837e46a350f38689b961035ff545661d50a.png] 

5) Sitting position of all 8 people is :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5c0312e602226027b8f631e42466e08d5333a5cb311532c8f2119c3aa1a509f4.png] 

∴ Here, W is sitting between P and V.

Hence, the correct answer is **"W".**
